FAQ

How does Instant Rakeback work?

A portion of every eligible wager builds your Instant Rakeback. When it is available, claim it straight into your selected wallet.

How does Weekly Rakeback work?

Your completed weekly activity is assessed when the reward period ends. If you qualify, the claim button becomes available here.

How does Monthly Rakeback work?

Your completed monthly activity is assessed at the end of the reward period. Eligible rewards are then made available to claim.

How are Weekly and Monthly rewards calculated?

They use eligible wager activity and your net result for that period, with extra weighting for losing periods. Pending amounts stay hidden until they are ready.
